comment: Third-party installers bundled into Zentriq-Setup-x64.exe. Get-Prerequisites.ps1 downloads them, verifies the Authenticode signature (valid chain + expected publisher) and, when sha256 is set, the exact hash. Pin sha256 after the first verified download (the build prints it) so every later build bundles byte-identical files.
